items.title: Lots of reports filed — the knowledge base still cites the wrong passages
items.subtitle: Finance RAG · parsing and chunking · rerank and eval
items.description: A mid-size research/news team: docs were ingested, Q&A still missed the point. Goal: a shippable knowledge Q&A with an observable pipeline. Fix parsing and chunking first, then add freshness/authority rerank — not a bigger model.

Added freshness and source-authority rerank plus recall-path logging and eval
Delivered scalable Docker Compose deploy with handoff and rollback in mind

items.title: Scans and messy layouts drag the whole RAG project into the mud
items.subtitle: PDF / OCR / TOC / watermark cleanup
items.description: Common enterprise KB blockers: scans, tables, watermarks, missing TOC hierarchy. Goal: turn dirty docs into structured, searchable input. Prefer rules + coordinates when stable; bring VL/OCR when layout complexity demands it.
highlights: Built PDF structure parsing and table recognition into clean Markdown/trees
Rule-based cleanup to lift OCR baselines; three-tier TOC extraction fallback
Wrapped high-concurrency parse APIs for downstream chunking and embedding

items.title: As the group scales, risk control / escrow / support cannot stay manual
items.subtitle: Community bot · escrow reconciliation · observability
items.description: A commercial community outgrew manual verification, anti-spam, escrow trades, and support tickets. Delivery focus: stability, reconciliation loops, and operable ops — not feature sprawl.
highlights: Automated join verification, anti-spam, and risk governance
Built VIP-group escrow and financial reconciliation to cut human error
Shipped an ops console and ticketing for a monitorable commercial loop

businessFlows.title: Business flows
businessFlows.subtitle: Locate capability by where you are stuck - not by a wall of tech cards

flows.title: Knowledge base, 0 to production
flows.subtitle: Full RAG chain - from dirty docs to a shippable Q&A gateway
flows.persona: If you are a tech/business lead: docs piled up, answers are wrong, will not ship
flows.oneLiner: Do not swap for a bigger model first - fix parsing, chunking, rerank, and the gateway

nodes.painPoint: Scans, tables, watermarks, missing TOC - dirty docs feed dirty knowledge
nodes.painDetail: The most common blocker is upstream: PDF structure lost, tables garbled, watermarks over text, TOC missing. No downstream tweak can save this.

projects.title: High-Precision PDF Structuring Engine
projects.how: Reverse-engineers PDF coordinates via low-level libs to extract text/tables/hierarchy as the cleanest data source

projects.title: Smart PDF Watermark Removal
projects.how: Configurable rule base + visual coordinate matching for batch watermark removal, raising the OCR baseline

projects.title: Multimodal OCR Visual Service
projects.how: OCR + layout understanding wrapped as a high-concurrency API - upload a scan and get structured output

projects.title: Deep Report TOC Extraction
projects.how: Bookmark extraction -> TOC page parsing -> layout understanding, a three-tier fallback

projects.title: Ultra-Fast GPU Layout Detection
projects.how: GPU inference cluster acceleration with high-concurrency async ingest, dismantling charts/tables/paragraphs

nodes.painPoint: Naive chunking shreds tables and severs context - recall ceiling locked
nodes.painDetail: Chunking is the hidden ceiling of RAG precision. Hard character splits tear tables and cut context; even perfect recall cannot reassemble full meaning.

projects.title: Report Smart Semantic Chunking
projects.how: Layout-aware chunking for financial reports, recognizing table shapes and emitting clean Markdown

projects.title: Adaptive Multi-Format Chunking
projects.how: One chunking pipeline for all source formats, streaming into a GPU production ingest path

nodes.painPoint: Keyword-only hits miss semantics; chart data is invisible to search
nodes.painDetail: Default BM25 cannot match paraphrases, and chart content is a blind spot. Charts and text need dual-track vectorization to be retrievable.

projects.title: Qwen3 Vector Retrieval Platform
projects.how: Qwen3 Embedding + PGVector recall microservice, tuned for vertical-industry semantic hit rates

projects.title: Multimodal Report Retrieval
projects.how: Dual-track vector storage for inline charts and text in PDFs, answering chart-data and text-evidence queries

nodes.painPoint: Dumping top-k into the LLM cites the wrong passage and answers miss the point
nodes.painDetail: Recalled top-k mixes stale and weakly-relevant snippets that mislead the LLM. You need freshness/authority rerank plus eval logs.

projects.title: Retrieval Reranker
projects.how: Semantic rerank and dedup over recall candidates, fusing freshness and source authority for better citations

nodes.painPoint: Manual ingest cannot scale and cannot roll back
nodes.painDetail: At volume, manual ingest is slow and lossy. You need an async ingest cluster with scalable deployment for throughput and handoff/rollback.

projects.title: Massive Long-Doc Async Ingestion
projects.how: Celery + Docker async distributed document system for automated report ingest and vectorization orchestration

nodes.painPoint: No auth, audit, or logging - cannot go to production
nodes.painDetail: Internal demos can run raw, but production needs auth, call logs, and audit. The gateway must wrap retrieval and generation behind a standard OpenAPI.

projects.title: Enterprise Conversational Q&A Gateway
projects.how: Standard conversational RAG OpenAPI wrapping retrieval and generation with auth and call-log auditing

flows.title: Agent, demo to production
flows.subtitle: Agent engineering - tool orchestration / code exec / multi-agent
flows.persona: If you are a CTO/tech lead: agent demos look great but break on new scenes, will not ship
flows.oneLiner: Embed tool orchestration, code execution, and multi-agent into an auditable engineering flow

nodes.painPoint: Hard-coded tools break on new scenes; static toolchains cannot generalize
nodes.painDetail: Tool calls baked into code mean every new tool needs a logic change. LLMs need to write code in a sandbox and mount tools on demand.

projects.title: Sandboxed Code Execution & Tool Proxy
projects.how: Empowers LLMs to dynamically write and execute code in isolated sandboxes and mount tools on demand

nodes.painPoint: Multi-tool coordination via hand-written if-else is not reusable
nodes.painDetail: Chaining tools with spaghetti if-else means rewriting for every new intent. You need natural-language-driven call-chain planning.

projects.title: MCP Service Orchestration Engine
projects.how: Plans multi-tool call chains from natural language, with context-aware intent decomposition and concurrent execution

nodes.painPoint: Every system calls the LLM directly - AI API assets are out of control
nodes.painDetail: Each business system connects to the LLM on its own; calls are scattered, costs run out of control, governance is impossible. A middle layer must aggregate AI API assets.

projects.title: Enterprise Model Capability Gateway
projects.how: Unified AI tool scheduling middleware shielding business systems from direct LLM complexity, with centralized control and routing

nodes.painPoint: A single agent cannot hold complex tasks - cannot split, routing is messy
nodes.painDetail: A single agent drifts as context grows. Complex tasks need multi-role collaboration: autonomous decomposition, multi-round routing, automated execution loops.

projects.title: Complex Multi-Agent Collaboration
projects.how: Multi-role agent network for autonomous task decomposition, multi-round routing, and automated execution loops

nodes.painPoint: No controllable execution environment - mobile/edge scenes cannot plug in
nodes.painDetail: Much business happens on mobile/edge, but agents have no controllable environment to plug into. You need cloud-phone fleet control plus standard APIs.

projects.title: Phone AutoGLM Fleet Platform
projects.how: AutoGLM-based cloud-phone fleet: web console + REST APIs for command dispatch, progress polling, and media import

flows.title: Finance research content
flows.subtitle: From attachment collection to intraday anomalies - automate the research pipeline
flows.persona: If you are a finance/news team: too many reports, labor is expensive, workflows are broken
flows.oneLiner: From attachment collection to intraday anomalies - automate the research pipeline

nodes.painPoint: Report attachments scattered across inboxes - manual moving is slow and lossy
nodes.painDetail: Reports pile up in inboxes daily; manual download, rename, and ingest is slow and leaky. You need RPA auto-polling plus email intel routing.

projects.title: Report Attachment RPA Crawler
projects.how: Auto-polls inboxes and extracts key data tables from attached reports into standard structured ledgers

projects.title: Email Intel Automated Routing
projects.how: Real-time monitoring of core inboxes, extracting high-value email via custom rules and routing across platforms

nodes.painPoint: Entity/time extraction is inaccurate; business semantics are weak
nodes.painDetail: Regex extraction of company names, dates, and metrics from reports misses and errs; downstream aggregation cannot get accurate. You need custom NER plus auto-tagging.

projects.title: High-Precision Financial NER
projects.how: Custom financial entity extraction with knowledge-graph recall and earnings-cycle logic parsing for stronger semantic understanding

projects.title: Financial News Smart Tagging
projects.how: NLP models auto-tag and classify massive announcements and news for downstream aggregation and push

nodes.painPoint: Nobody watches intraday anomalies - risk lags, opportunities slip away
nodes.painDetail: Manual monitoring of intraday market and news anomalies is unrealistic; by the time you see it, it is too late. You need millisecond listening plus multi-dimensional quant scoring plus real-time alerts.

projects.title: Intraday ETF Quant Monitoring
projects.how: Millisecond market and news anomaly engine, auto-evaluating risk across multi-dimensional quant indicators for real-time alerts

projects.title: High-Freq Asset Trading Monitor
projects.how: Low-latency trade-data listeners plus Redis high-speed dedup, pushing core trading intel in milliseconds

nodes.painPoint: Evaluation and generation are tangled - parsing is not rigorous
nodes.painDetail: In education scenarios, evaluating and generating the same question lets the LLM self-endorse. You need to separate evaluation from generation and support multi-round verification.

projects.title: Multi-LLM Education Parsing Engine
projects.how: Complex question-type routing network, separating evaluation and generation, with multi-round auto-verification for rigor

flows.title: Community monetization & office automation
flows.subtitle: Hand moderation, leads, and collaboration to bots and automation
flows.persona: If you run a community/private-domain: group scale outgrew manual ops
flows.oneLiner: Hand moderation, leads, and collaboration to bots and automation

nodes.painPoint: Verification, anti-spam, escrow, and support tickets cannot stay manual
nodes.painDetail: After growth, join verification, anti-spam, escrow trades, and support tickets cannot stay manual. Focus: stability, reconciliation loop, and operational control.

projects.title: Community Ops & Monetization Hub
projects.how: All-in-one community ops solution covering anti-fraud risk control, escrow trading, and smart customer service as a monitorable loop

nodes.painPoint: Opportunities in chat slip through the flood of messages
nodes.painDetail: Tens of thousands of messages a day are impossible to scan manually; complementary opportunities are lost. You need 24/7 listening plus LLM intent extraction plus targeted delivery.

projects.title: Community Lead Insight Radar
projects.how: 24/7 full-volume monitoring of community dynamics, LLM-extracted business intents, capturing complementary opportunities in real time

nodes.painPoint: Chat history is a black box - valuable info cannot be found
nodes.painDetail: Group history is a huge information mine, but full-text search cannot find semantically similar content. You need full-text plus vector dual-track recall.

projects.title: Community History Smart Search
projects.how: Dual-track retrieval fusing full-text search and vector similarity, mining valuable info from massive chat histories

nodes.painPoint: Feishu/email/desktop data is siloed - manual reconciliation is costly
nodes.painDetail: Feishu sheets and backend systems are disconnected, requiring manual order-status sync; desktop work is repetitive. You need bidirectional data pipelines plus desktop AI enhancement.

projects.title: Enterprise Data Synergy Pipeline
projects.how: Bridges Lark multidimensional tables and backend systems for bidirectional real-time sync of orders and client info, eliminating manual reconciliation

projects.title: AI-Enhanced Smart Clipboard
projects.how: Rust-based desktop tool that listens and reshapes clipboard content with LLMs in real time, bridging workflows
